mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 205 triggers inflationary concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 205.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of very low federal funds rates (below 3.5%) and high unemployment rates (above 4.5%) signals weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (supply contraction) during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO declines in late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand growth) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 shows sustained quarterly growth.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the HOUST index above 1800 signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1800.

mechanism_narrative: A rising RSAFS (demand) alongside a falling FEDFUNDS rate (easing) signals expanding demand and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rising AND FEDFUNDS falling below 4.0%
regime_hint: expanding demand and easing monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS rises and FEDFUNDS falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) during a post-shock recovery phase signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE declines in post-shock recovery periods.
